title: Global variable used in one script only
description:
Code-style rule — global ($$) variables that are set and read within a single script. A local ($) variable would express the intent better.

Based on the PMD rule GlobalVariable — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_ecmascript_bestpractices.html#globalvariable
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A global used in one script leaks session-wide state for no reason.
rule.remediation: Downgrade the variable to local scope ($).
